title: 非局所的記憶の剥落に関する記述的考察：事例番号09-Ω
author: 学者 ヘルマン

en.title: A Descriptive Study on the Erosion of Non-local Memory: Case No. 09-Ω
en.premise: In a digital world where the memories of all humanity are preserved, an unexplained data loss phenomenon known as "Semantic Erosion" has begun to occur. Investigator Hermann recovers fragments of a "festival night" and a "letter without a recipient" from a corrupted sector. These are the records of a fatal emotion—one that humanity intentionally erased when they abandoned their physical bodies.

zh.title: 关于非局域性记忆剥落的描述性考察：案例编号 09-Ω
zh.premise: 在保存着全人类记忆的数字世界中，一种原因不明的数据消失现象——“语义剥落”正在发生。调查员赫尔曼从损坏的扇区中回收了“祭典之夜”的景象与一封“失去寄件地址的信件”的碎片。那是人类在抛弃肉体时，被刻意抹除的一段致命情感的记录。
